{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only adds a single line to doc/files.md documenting the new index directory, which is secondary to the index implementation.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Non-member: documentation changes are mechanical follow-ons to the new index."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds a complete new optional index under src/index/txoscriptindex.{h,cpp} with custom ordered varint key encoding.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.68,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds a major new index type that has been repeatedly requested since 2013 to index outputs by script without requiring the wallet. The author demonstrates viable performance with a ~61 GB index that syncs in a few hours and supports pruned nodes."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements the getscripthistory RPC in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp and refactors common transaction JSON formatting in src/rpc/rawtransaction_util.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Introduces getscripthistory to address a major programmatic gap that forced light-wallet servers and node operators into running external indexing databases. The query interface supports descriptors, raw scripts, and spending lookups, though reviewers noted resource accounting concerns on block reads."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in test files are functional and unit tests covering the new index and RPC specifically, with only registration in test_runner.py.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Non-member: does not touch general test framework machinery or harnesses."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touched src/init.cpp only for startup initialization and cache allocation wiring for the new index.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Non-member: startup adjustments merely connect the new index component."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 3,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
